actions: v View file, s Save, i Install, r Revert, n New
note: Restore is on o and in the key line, not in the tab bar. The first change to a draft with no sections also writes version = 1. Revert, Restore and New replace the whole draft. A terminal takes a look from the draft's looks, which the Looks tab makes, and the Flow view writes only the head's look = line; it makes and prunes no look (ADR-1205 D1).

Manages the looks, each a [look NAME] section with its font set, size, color scheme, vtlook and pointer theme. It assembles each look's font set by role from the active fonts, offers only the sizes those fonts supply, picks the look's color scheme and its vtlook from the Effects tab's list, and picks the look's pointer theme from the active ones (ADR-1205 D6, D7, D10; ADR-1304 D4). It lists the color schemes, the built-in ones and the scheme files, activates or deactivates each file, and previews a scheme as its 16 colors beside text in its foreground on its background (ADR-1205 D10). A pointer theme is activated by its folder (ADR-1205 D4). It writes head only to set the look = line of a head that names no look, and the top-level allow-window-ops only on y to its question.

A tab of its own, for font files only (ADR-1205 D1). Lists the font files found in the well-known folders, grouped by folder, with a filter line for simple filters, and shows each file's family, what it covers and its sizes once the font helper has described it. It activates or deactivates each file with Activate and Deactivate, and asks first when a look uses the font. It lists a font in a user's folder as not usable, previews the highlighted font, and installs a user's font as a system font, a privileged step of its own that writes nothing into the draft (ADR-1205 D3, D4, D5, D8). It tries no font on the console: the Looks tab tries a font set with t.

A tab of its own (ADR-1205 D1). Lists the vtlooks first: the built-in vtlook as No filter, then the presets, then the administrator's vtlooks (ADR-1304 D4). Then it lists the color maps and shaders found in ADR-1304's folders, with each one's trust mark, and activates or deactivates each with the Fonts tab's controls. The tab previews an effect as a picture of the console with the effect applied, and lists a color map or shader from a user's folder as not usable (ADR-1205 D3, D8).

Lists every top-level key of vtium.conf and edits each one, font-paths and allow-font-ops among them. It shows the keys by the sections and groups of vtium-settings' SECTIONS table, never as one flat list: it opens on the sections, and Enter opens one.
The form of the Looks tab that builds a font set by role from the active fonts: a text font, then a font for each other role the set fills (ADR-1205 D6). It shows under the Looks tab.
